title: Stetson Bennett takes control of Rams backup QB battle: ‘Gamer’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Stetson Bennett takes control of Rams backup QB battle: ‘Gamer’
sources.description: Stetson Bennett delivered his strongest statement yet in the Rams’ backup quarterback battle, outplaying rookie Ty Simpson in a 34-0 win over the Saints.
